tip: In the passive, door marks the agent, the one doing the action. De brief is door haar geschreven = the letter was written by her.
Start a sentence with an adverb and the verb comes before the subject. Langzamerhand vervaagden de contouren: verb before subject.
Doch is a formal, literary word for maar (but). Doch de waarheid bleek weerbarstiger dan verwacht.
Dienen te plus an infinitive is a formal way to say moeten (should/must). Er dient te worden opgemerkt = it should be noted.
Laat ons plus an infinitive means let us, a formal version of laten we. Laat ons de toekomst met vertrouwen tegemoet treden.
Dutch uses liggen (to lie) for objects resting in a place, where English just says are. De pepernoten liggen in de winkels.
